name: vnd.dovecot.debug
desc: Allows logging custom debug messages within Sieve scripts.

name: vnd.dovecot.environment
desc: Extends standard environment extension with Dovecot metadata and variables namespace.

name: vnd.dovecot.execute
desc: Executes a pre-defined set of external programs and processes string data.

name: vnd.dovecot.filter
desc: Filters complete email messages through a pre-defined set of external programs.

name: vnd.dovecot.pipe
desc: Pipes email messages directly to external program inputs.

name: vnd.dovecot.report
desc: Implements sending Messaging Abuse Reporting Format (MARF) reports (RFC 5965).
